author: National Geographic
description:
National Geographic Explorer and photographer Kiliii Yüyan’s journey continues at the Whaleback Shell Midden State Historic Site, a state park in Damariscotta, Maine. Here, the remnants of ancient oyster shells provide a reminder to visitors that rivers have been a source of life here for thousands of years. 

Come back next week to see more of Kiliii's adventures in our Maine Mondays series.
